visual.name: arFlashTickerSelector
visual.description: Interactive, field-driven KPI ticker and category cards with native Power BI selection.

dataRoles.name: visibleMetric
dataRoles.description: One or more numeric fields/measures at the mapped record grain.

dataRoles.name: selectionIdentity
dataRoles.description: Stable business identifier shared with the detail table/model.

dataRoles.name: flashFilterColumn
dataRoles.description: Optional fields used by matching-row rules and date filters.

dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: Optional category. Each category creates independently selectable metric items.

dataRoles.name: target
dataRoles.description: Optional target aggregated across the same matching rows.

dataRoles.name: badge
dataRoles.description: Optional text badge. Multiple distinct values within one category display their count with names in the tooltip; no external images.

dataRoles.name: tooltip
dataRoles.description: Additional supplied values shown in tooltips.

height.description: Height of the ticker strip inside the report visual. Limited by available viewport space; it does not resize the Power BI visual container. Cards and Compact use their own content layout.

speedSeconds.description: Travel duration for ticker animations. Bounce uses the separate Bounce cycle control.

repeatGap.description: Spacing after a complete repeated sequence: Compact 16 px, Comfortable 48 px, Wide 96 px. Available only for repeating ticker animations.

pauseOnHover.description: Pauses while the pointer is over ticker content, not while over the Pause/Resume or Clear controls. Keyboard focus pauses only on metric items.

metricAggregation.description: Use additive row-level values. Non-additive measures should use the appropriate aggregation or a dedicated model measure at the intended grain.

animationMode.description: PingPong moves horizontally back and forth. Bounce moves vertically. RightToLeft is a single pass with re-entry; Marquee repeats continuously.

clearVisibility.description: Available in all layouts because every layout can filter other visuals. Auto shows when selected; Always stays visible; Hidden removes the button. Escape clears this visual selection, not report/page/slicer filters.

bounceCycleSeconds.description: Duration of one visible bounce. Independent of the longer ticker travel duration; lower is faster.

bounceHeight.description: Requested vertical travel, bounded to the free space inside the strip so text is not clipped. Increase Ticker height when necessary.

clickBehavior.description: Select one replaces the previous item and keeps it selected on repeated clicks. Multi-select adds/removes individual items. Ctrl/Cmd-click temporarily adds/removes. Legacy Toggle is read as Select one; Clear or Escape clears selection.

badgePosition.description: Available when Badge Text is mapped or a non-None built-in symbol is selected, and optional badges are On.

symbol.description: Only used without a Badge Text binding. Bound single values show text; multiple values show a count with their names in the native tooltip. Saved symbols are preserved while hidden.

badgeSize.description: Available when Badge Text is mapped or a non-None built-in symbol is selected, and optional badges are On.

pauseButton.description: Ticker only. Visible control is available for active animation; Cards and Compact are static, including animated text effects.

applyOnClick.description: Click a metric to filter related visuals. An active selection is recalculated when dates/rules change. With no active selection, rules affect this visual only until you click.

dateColumnName.description: Choose a mapped date field; no typed column name.

filter1Value.description: Values come from supplied rows. For multiple values, prefer Power BI visual-level filters. Legacy comma-separated rules are still read.

filter2Value.description: Values come from supplied rows. For multiple values, prefer Power BI visual-level filters. Legacy comma-separated rules are still read.

filter3Value.description: Values come from supplied rows. For multiple values, prefer Power BI visual-level filters. Legacy comma-separated rules are still read.

filter4Value.description: Values come from supplied rows. For multiple values, prefer Power BI visual-level filters. Legacy comma-separated rules are still read.

filter5Value.description: Values come from supplied rows. For multiple values, prefer Power BI visual-level filters. Legacy comma-separated rules are still read.

filter6Value.description: Values come from supplied rows. For multiple values, prefer Power BI visual-level filters. Legacy comma-separated rules are still read.

maxSelectionRows.description: Safety limit on distinct Power BI row identities across the complete selection, not on visible cards. One card can represent many identities. No partial selection is sent. Legacy reports retain the lower of their two old identity limits until this property is edited.

maxSelectedItems.description: Maximum explicitly selected items (1 means one card, 2 means two). Applies to Cards, Ticker and Compact, including Ctrl/Cmd selection. Repeated ticker copies do not count twice. Underlying row-identity safety is a separate limit.

rowIdentityLimit.description: Distinct Power BI row identities across the entire selection, not card count. One card can represent many rows. No partial selection is sent. Saved legacy limits are respected until this setting is changed.

show.description: Uses the native Power BI tooltip. Its font and frame are controlled by Power BI, not by this visual.
